text.en:
After a Melee Kill, for 7.5 seconds:
Weapon Kills cause the enemy to explode, dealing up to <pve 123.5 /> <pvp [?] /> damage over a 4.5? meter radius.

Explosions inherit the weapon's <link Combatant Damage Scaling [#CombatantScaling] />.
